from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485762/attempts/600043634274485a8fca1406353e4b51/system/state/workspace/programs/task-26ec5493.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}, key=lambda color: min(c for row in grid for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color))
    objects = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        objects.append((color, [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]))
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    y = x = 0
    for i, (color, shape) in enumerate(objects):
        for r, row in enumerate(shape):
            for c, value in enumerate(row):
                if value and y + r < h and x + c < w:
                    out[y + r][x + c] = value
        if i + 1 < len(objects):
            y += len(shape) - 1
            x += len(shape[0]) - 1
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p, p.exists())
